Subject: Your breach of contract matter

Dear Ms. Qureshi,

Thank you for meeting us on 19/10/2020 about your dispute with M/s Coastal Industries. As we understand it, the goods supplied were defective. The matter is listed before the Kochi Commercial Court.

Our advice is to claim liquidated damages as fixed in the contract. Please collect the inspection reports and the rejection notices and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
